title: BA-FedSHAP: Background-Anchored Federated Shapley Attributions for Auditable AI
description: Reference implementation and raw experimental results for the SoftwareX article: BA-FedSHAP — Background-Anchored Federated Shapley Attributions for Auditable AI. Includes the full BA-FedSHAP protocol (Algorithms 1–3), six comparison baselines, faithfulness metrics, RDP privacy accounting, and reproducible results on COMPAS, Adult, German Credit, Bank Marketing, ACSIncome, and ACSPublicCoverage.
